verified: Anthropic’s Claude article, as summarized by Techmeme, says the beta “Install as app” feature lets users open Claude artifacts as Mac and Windows apps with notifications and optional full computer access.
unconfirmed: Which artifact types can be installed, whether the beta is open to all Claude users or a limited group, and what “full computer access” permits or how it is gated; no independent test is available.

verified: 据 Anthropic 官方公告，该 beta 功能可将 Claude artifacts 安装为 Mac 和 Windows 桌面应用，支持通知，并提供可选的完整电脑访问权限。
unconfirmed: 哪些套餐与地区可用、是否收费、beta 结束时间，以及“完整电脑访问”具体能读写什么、如何授权，公告均未说明，也没有独立测试或用户实测结果。

titles.en: Claude artifacts can be installed as Mac and Windows apps in beta
titles.zh: Anthropic 测试“Install as app”：Claude artifact 可装成 Mac 和 Windows 应用
